objects.description: UI uses ArkUI @State to drive refresh; keep a loading state until Preferences are read; adding items is allowed only after loading completes.
objects.reason: @State UI with loading state.

objects.description: Implement add, toggle complete/restore, delete, all/active/completed filtering, and count statistics.
objects.reason: Stats reactive.

objects.description: Complete a real HarmonyOS Stage ArkTS TodoList app using SDK API 21 with the existing empty project and EntryAbility.
objects.reason: Stable ids implemented.

objects.description: Logic lives in standalone pure file entry/src/main/ets/model/TodoModel.ets with no SDK or third-party imports, and it must actually be used by the UI.
objects.reason: Preferences put+flush serialized.

objects.description: Reject titles that are pure whitespace; allow at most 80 characters after trim; support Chinese and duplicate titles; IDs must be unique and stable.
objects.reason: 80-char cap restored; no exemption claimed.

objects.description: Single-page UI with stable element ids: todo-input, add-button, filter-all, filter-active, filter-completed, todo-row-<id>, toggle-<id>, delete-<id>.
objects.reason: Restore/ID semantics correct.

objects.description: Export interface TodoItem { id: string; title: string; completed: boolean } and export type TodoFilter = 'all' | 'active' | 'completed'.
objects.reason: Pure-logic model API matches spec.

objects.description: restore uses serialize's format, restores each item's ID and completed state, and subsequently added IDs must not collide with restored IDs.
objects.reason: Error paths explicit and non-silent.

objects.description: The loadFromStore error path must not silently clear the model and continue as loaded: keep known data, display a clear error, and prevent overwriting the store with an empty list as if a successful read occurred; a normal first-run empty store must still allow adding items.
objects.reason: Load error path preserves data and blocks overwrite.

objects.description: The persist path must not silently return when saving is unavailable; when the store cannot be used or saving fails, show an explicit error instead of pretending success (read/save exceptions must not masquerade as success).
objects.reason: Persist error surfaces to user.

objects.description: If an error type is used for the error paths, use an explicit type supported by the SDK/ArkTS (e.g. BusinessError).
objects.reason: BusinessError explicit type used.

objects.description: Verify the count-statistics UI's @State dependencies so the numbers refresh; the UI must not read only the private model in a way that bypasses state observation.
objects.reason: Stats @State dependency satisfied.

objects.description: Ensure that completing (toggle), restoring, deleting, filtering, and the count statistics all refresh immediately on the current page after user actions.
objects.reason: Toggle immediate refresh addressed via key + copies.

objects.description: The agent must perform the business-source fix using native tools and accept RC final review of the fix.
objects.reason: Delivered for RC final review without self-verification claims.
